newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong has 1.2 mln mobile phone users - survey.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong has 1.2 mln mobile phone users - survey.

text.p: There were 1.2 million mobile telephone users in Hong Kong as at the end of December, Survey Research Hongkong Ltd said on Monday.
That represents an increase of 500,000 users during 1996, the company said in a statement, quoting a recent survey.
If current growth rates persists, there will almost be 2 million users by the end of 1997, it said.
The launch of Personal Communciations Services (PCS) mobile telephone networks at the beginning of the year is likely to help deliver that number, it said.
Hong Kong's population stood at 6.42 million at the end of 1996.
